verdict.rationale: Figma documents a built-in Figma agent that can "edit images" and generate design directions inside the product, backed by a shared AI-credit system, so in-editor AI asset help exists. The specific chores named in the story are not individually evidenced. missing for 10: explicit image generation, background removal, content-aware fill, copy/text suggestions, depth of image-editing docs, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a designer, built-in AI handles asset chores — image generation, background removal, content-aware fills, copy suggestions — inside the editor

citations.quote: Use the Figma agent to generate new design directions, create diagrams, edit images, search your files, and more.
Purchase AI credits for your whole team to share.
Teammates and AI agents work in the same space with shared context. Generate new design directions, refine, and align—together.
